title: Variance in C#
versionPolicy: latest stable at generation; note recently introduced major changes; identify preview features and date source checks

sections.title: Reference conversions and substitutability
sections.prompt: Explain identity and implicit reference conversions, inheritance, assignment direction, and invariance with compile and noncompile examples.

sections.title: Covariance and out
sections.prompt: Explain declaration-site out, reference conversions, IEnumerable and IReadOnlyList, read-only view versus underlying mutability, and safe producer examples.

sections.title: Contravariance and in
sections.prompt: Explain reversed conversions using Action and IComparer, consuming values, and concrete compile and noncompile examples.

sections.title: Variance safety and nested positions
sections.prompt: Explain formal input-safe and output-safe rules, nested delegates, non-virtual static member exceptions, ref parameters, and counterexamples.

sections.title: Delegate variance and method group conversion
sections.prompt: Distinguish delegate generic variance, method group signature variance, Func, Action, delegate combination and runtime restrictions.

sections.title: Value types boxing and constraints
sections.prompt: Explain why generic variance conversions require reference conversions, boxing is not generic variance, nullable and constraints with examples.

sections.title: Array covariance and runtime checks
sections.prompt: Explain reference-array covariance, ArrayTypeMismatchException, multidimensional arrays and alternatives; give tested examples.

sections.title: BCL variant interfaces and delegates
sections.prompt: Inventory the public variant generic interfaces and delegates in the selected .NET release, with type parameters, variance annotations, methods and evidence; flag omissions.

sections.title: Interview and practice
sections.prompt: Include graduated questions and answers, compilable examples, invalid-code exercises, interview follow-ups and misconception analysis.
